name: Delavirdine Mesylate

examples.title: Quality of Life of HIV-infected Participants Switched to Raltegravir Versus Other Antiretroviral Regimens (MK-0518-266)
examples.why: The trial was terminated early due to slow recruitment.

summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, evaluated warning signs for Delavirdine Mesylate [M]. This model produced a high score of 76 for liver concerns and a low score of 27 for heart concerns [M]. Additionally, one clinical study involving the drug was stopped early because it had slow recruitment of participants [4].
